$comment: Third-party systems detected from rendered page content, link targets, asset hosts and generator meta tags. Scope limit: this was a content extraction, not a full script/tag audit - client-side tracking tags embedded in <script> were not enumerated. Absence below means 'not observed in the extracted content', not 'proven absent'.
auditScope: Rendered markdown, link targets, image hosts, and metadata across 26 live pages plus one subdomain.

bookingSystems.name: LeadConnector / HighLevel (GoHighLevel)
bookingSystems.coverage: Every page of southdademusic.com, including the 404 template
bookingSystems.notes: apisystem.tech is a white-label domain in the HighLevel family. This single widget is the site's only lead-capture mechanism. No calendar/scheduler UI was observed - it is a survey form, not a booking calendar.

bookingSystems.name: LeadConnector funnel (try.southdademusic.com)
bookingSystems.detectedVia: favicon stcdn.leadconnectorhq.com, assets on assets.cdn.filesafe.space, images proxied via images.leadconnectorhq.com, URL redirect to /offer-page
bookingSystems.notes: A SECOND, separate HighLevel property. Different phone number, different address, different brand name. Leads captured here are in a separate flow from the main site with no cross-attribution.

paymentSystems.notes: No Stripe, PayPal, Square, Authorize.net or any checkout was observed on southdademusic.com. The camp requires a non-refundable down payment 'today' with no on-site payment path and no disclosed amount. Payment is presumably collected inside the HighLevel widget or offline - UNVERIFIED. This must be confirmed before rebuilding the enrolment flow.

formsNote: ZERO native forms exist on southdademusic.com. No contact form, no enquiry form, no enrolment form, no newsletter signup, no member login.

crmTools.name: HighLevel (GoHighLevel) CRM
crmTools.detectedVia: inferred from the LeadConnector widget and funnel - HighLevel bundles CRM, pipelines and automation with its forms/funnels
crmTools.notes: Three distinct HighLevel sub-account identifiers appear in asset URLs on the subdomain, suggesting either multiple sub-accounts, an agency parent account, or assets borrowed from a template account. Ownership of the HighLevel account (agency vs client) must be confirmed - it holds the lead database.

emailMarketingTools.name: HighLevel (assumed, bundled)
emailMarketingTools.notes: No Mailchimp, Klaviyo, ConvertKit or standalone ESP was observed. No newsletter signup exists anywhere on the site. If email marketing runs, it runs through HighLevel.

analytics.notes: No analytics provider was observable in the extracted content. GA4, GTM and similar load via <script> tags which this extraction did not enumerate. A direct tag audit is required. Given the site runs a HighLevel funnel and a separate WordPress site with no shared attribution, conversion tracking is very likely incomplete regardless.

metaPixel.name: Meta (Facebook) Pixel
metaPixel.notes: Not observable in extracted content. Requires a script-level audit. Note that no Facebook page is linked from anywhere on the site.

googleServices.name: Google Maps
googleServices.detectedVia: try.southdademusic.com static map image and place link (query_place_id=EjM2MDEgVyBQYWxtIERyIHVuaXQgMTE3...)
googleServices.notes: The ONLY Google Maps presence in the estate is on the subdomain. southdademusic.com has no map at all. The place_id confirms a Google Business Profile record exists for '601 W Palm Dr unit 117'.

googleServices.name: Google Business Profile
googleServices.detectedVia: inferred - the place_id above, plus 14 testimonials whose format and content strongly indicate Google reviews
googleServices.notes: No GBP link, review widget, or aggregate rating appears on any page. This is a significant unused asset.

googleServices.name: Google Fonts
googleServices.notes: Not observable in extracted content; would require a script/stylesheet audit.

googleServices.name: Firebase Storage (highlevel-backend.appspot.com)
googleServices.detectedVia: the static map image URL on try.southdademusic.com
googleServices.notes: HighLevel's own backend storage, not a direct Google integration by the business.

videoPlatforms.notes: NO YouTube, Vimeo, Wistia or self-hosted video appears anywhere in the estate. Zero video assets were found across 26 pages. For a performance-based academy this is a major content gap.

socialMediaLinks.notes: ZERO social links on any live page - no Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, X, LinkedIn or WhatsApp. The only trace is the word 'Instagram' in the index metadata of the now-404 /events/month/2025-03/ archive, indicating a profile existed and the link was lost in migration. The homepage advertises 'Call, text, or WhatsApp' with no WhatsApp link present.

scholarshipPortals.name: Step Up for Students
scholarshipPortals.notes: PEP and UA scholarships are promoted on 4+ pages and the homepage renders two Step Up for Students LOGO images (/wp-content/themes/south-dade-music/images/step-up-for-students-1.png and -2.png), but there is NO link to stepupforstudents.org, no application portal, no eligibility checker and no document list. Third-party logo usage rights need confirmation.

externalEnrollmentLinks.purpose: all enrolment, trial and camp reservation intents

cmsAndPlatform.removedPlugin: The Events Calendar - removed while its URLs remained published; /event/... and /events/month/... now 404
cmsAndPlatform.detectedVia: generator meta tags on every page

thirdPartyAssetHosts.notes: Production pages load a hero image from a third-party staging domain the business does not control. If that server goes away, 14 pages lose their hero. It also publicly exposes the agency's staging path structure (/south-dade-music/wp/). The identical file EXISTS on the live domain and is used correctly on /resources/ and /performances/ - so this is an unintended leak, not a CDN strategy. Also affects the 404 template.

thirdPartyAssetHosts.usage: Emoji images (🎹 🎸 🥁 🎻 🎤 📞 📍 🌐) on five instrument pages
thirdPartyAssetHosts.notes: Standard WordPress behaviour; adds external requests per page load. Should be replaced with native emoji or SVG in a rebuild.
The subdomain has no assets on infrastructure the business controls. If the HighLevel account lapses, the entire funnel and its imagery disappear.

criticalFindings: Lead capture is 100% dependent on a single third-party HighLevel widget with no on-site fallback form.
Two disconnected HighLevel properties (main site widget + try. funnel) with different phone numbers, no cross-linking and no shared attribution.
No payment system observable despite a non-refundable camp deposit being 'required today'.
No analytics or pixel observable in content - requires a script-level audit before any redesign, or historical data will be lost.
No video platform integration at all - zero video across the estate.
No social media links anywhere; an Instagram profile appears to have been lost in migration.
A staging domain is serving production images on 14+ pages.
Step Up for Students logos are used with no link and unconfirmed licensing.
HighLevel account ownership (agency vs business) is unknown and holds the lead database.
requiredBeforeRedesign: Run a script-level tag audit (GA4, GTM, Meta Pixel, any conversion tags) and record measurement IDs
Confirm who owns the HighLevel account and export the lead/contact database
Confirm how camp deposits are actually collected
Recover Instagram and any other social handles
Confirm the Google Business Profile and claim the review corpus
Decide the fate of try.southdademusic.com - retire, align, or keep as a paid-traffic LP
Remove all cmscustom-staginglink2.com references and re-point to local assets
